name: antifan-browser-desktop
description: Ultra-lightweight Chromium companion & Extension Bridge for AntiFan Browser
author: AntiFan Team

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.compile: node scripts/build-native-host-shim.mjs && node scripts/check-emit-integrity.mjs && tsc -p ./ && node scripts/check-mcp-budget-dominance.mjs && node scripts/prune-orphan-emit.mjs && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && npm run build:extension
scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:canary && npm run test:fast && npm run test:site-clone && npm run test:integration && npm run test:main && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm test
scripts.smoke:split: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-split-review.cjs
scripts.smoke:google: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-google-cookies.cjs
scripts.smoke:cdp-queue: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-tab-devtools-queue.cjs
scripts.smoke:vault: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-vault.cjs
scripts.smoke:soak: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-real-soak.cjs
scripts.smoke:multitasking: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-background-multitasking.cjs
scripts.smoke:parity: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke-playwright-parity.cjs
scripts.smoke:terminal: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs test/e2e/terminal-recovery-smoke.cjs && node scripts/run-electron.cjs test/e2e/terminal-renderer-smoke.cjs && node scripts/run-electron.cjs test/e2e/terminal-split-hydration-probe.cjs
scripts.test:terminal-transport: npm run compile && node scripts/run-electron.cjs test/e2e/terminal-transport-sync.cjs
